title: AlphaSense Continues Tegus Integration Following $930M Acquisition
summary: Inex One's February 2026 M&A tracker notes that AlphaSense continues to position Tegus content as part of its platform following the $930M acquisition in 2024. This is a market-status observation rather than a discrete announcement; the extent of full integration has not been independently verified.
whyItMatters: If fully realized, the Tegus integration would position AlphaSense as one of the largest combined expert transcript and intelligence platforms, potentially reshaping competitive dynamics across the industry.
